title: Conscious ignition is the formation of a synchronous complex

statements.text: The ignition events of global workspace theory are the crossing of a critical threshold for SOHM formation by self-synchronized neural activity, which forms metastable complexes of integrated information that act as neuronal global workspaces and implement Bayesian model selection.

sources.quote: IWMT specifically proposes that conscious ignition corresponds to surpassing critical thresholds for SOHM formation via self-synchronized neural activity
